content.title: Registry Entry: Pluto Classification as Dwarf Planet
content.body:
Document reference: OFFICIAL-SECONDARY-2024-04-10. Effective: 2024-04-10.

Summary: This registry entry records the official classification of Pluto as a dwarf planet, per the International Astronomical Union (IAU). The IAU classifies Pluto as a dwarf planet. This designation is based on criteria established by the IAU, which require that a celestial body orbit the Sun, have sufficient mass for hydrostatic equilibrium, and have not cleared its orbital neighborhood. Pluto meets the first two criteria but not the third, resulting in its classification. Consequently, Pluto is not considered a major planet in our solar system. The value as written: yes. This entry serves as a reference for researchers and the public, ensuring consistent understanding of planetary nomenclature.
